{{Top|leg}}
A '''Ralltiir tiger pit''', also known simply as a '''tiger pit''', was a trap employed by [[Big game hunter/Legends|big game hunters]]. The pits were holes dug into the ground, and covered over with foliage such as [[Reed (plant)/Legends|reeds]] to disguise the opening. At the bottom of the pit, a bed of [[vibro-stake]]s was positioned to impale anything that fell into the trap. [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]] had Ralltiir tiger pits on the grounds of his [[Tyro Viveca's estate|estate]].<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
